params.place: Black Canyon at night, the dam's curved face with the lake behind it

moments.what: the dam's pale curved face glows under floodlights, lit powerhouse windows at its foot
one row of powerhouse windows dims
the outlet water thins
the camera drifts up to the lake water pressing on the dam
the waterline slides down the canyon, leaving a white band

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Hoover Dam makes less power when Lake Mead drops.

params.place: beside an intake tower in the lake, its depth scale

moments.what: the camera glides toward an intake tower standing in the lake
close on the depth scale painted on the tower, its marks lighting up
the water slides down past the marks
the tower's windows dim as the camera pulls back

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Why does the height of a lake matter?

params.place: the powerhouse roof at the foot of the dam, power lines climbing the canyon

moments.what: the camera glides over the powerhouse roof between the canyon walls
the row of generator domes under the roof lights up one by one
the sign counts up to the figure
the transformer hums, its sparks crackling
the sign flashes as all the domes glow
the camera rises up the dam's face
white water bursts from the outlet pipes into the river
sparks race up the power lines over the canyon rim

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Historically, it made up to 2,074 megawatts. So how does water make power?

params.place: the lake and the canyon wall, sliced open

moments.what: glowing streams of water swirl toward the intake towers
the intake tower rises out of the water, a label writes on
the cut lake shows the tower standing on the bottom
the camera dives down with the water into the tower
a huge steel pipe lights up in the cutaway rock
water streaks rush down the pipe
pull back: the pipe runs through the canyon rock to the powerhouse

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Water rushes into towers and drops down steel pipes through the rock.

params.place: the turbine pit deep under the powerhouse

moments.what: the pipe's mouth opens into the spiral case around the runner
water streams hit the runner and it jolts
a label writes on: turbine
the curved blades light up one after another
close on the blades as water curls off them
the runner whirls faster, the camera orbits it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Below, it slams into a turbine's curved blades and spins it.

place: inside the generator, magnets and coils

moments.what: the shaft rises from below and turns the rotor
the rotor's ring of magnets rolls past
its red and blue magnets glow as they pass
the magnets streak past, the camera whipping with them
the copper coils around it shine
each coil flashes as a magnet sweeps by
a bright current runs out of the coils into a cable
the cable glows brighter
cut to the desert: the current races along power lines
the power lines glow all the way to the city
the first city's windows start switching on
city lights switch on across the plain, a sign counts up the figure

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The spin sweeps magnets past copper coils, sending electricity to about 1.3M people.

params.place: the lake in cross-section against the dam

moments.what: the lake slices open beside the dam
the camera sinks down the water column, darker blue with depth
pressure arrows press on the dam, bigger near the bottom
the bottom arrow at the intake pulses
the waterline glows
the water level slides down, the white band left behind
the arrows shrink and the water entering the pipe slows

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Deeper water pushes harder. When the lake drops, the push weakens.

params.place: the powerhouse control room, a giant output dial on the wall

moments.what: a report folder drops onto the desk
the report's title writes on above it
the folder opens
the big output dial on the wall lights up
a small wall screen flickers on
the screen shows the lake at a low level
the screen's waterline drops to the mark
the needle swings up the scale
the needle settles and the figure counts up on the dial
the dial's needle settles with a bounce
the dial's ring glows amber

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Engineers once estimated that at one low level, it could still make 1,302 megawatts.

params.place: the dam at the low lake, the white band towering over the water, the powerhouse going dark

moments.what: the camera glides over the low lake, the white band towering above it
the old figure on the powerhouse sign greys and a red line strikes it
the waterline glows against the white band as the camera dives to the powerhouse
the outlet water thins to a trickle
the new figure slams onto the sign in red and windows go dark
the last windows flicker out

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Its newer estimate for that same low lake? Just 382.

place: the powerhouse floor, an old runner and a crane lowering a new one
Black Canyon at night, the dam's curved face

moments.what: the old runner sits in its pit, worn and pitted
sparks and pits flash across its blades
a crane lowers a gleaming new runner beside it
a tag swings on the crane hook
the tag counts up the figure
the runner starts to turn
the roof opens above
the camera pulls up and out through the roof
the dam's face at night, the lake against it
the waterline slides down the concrete
the floodlit dam fills the frame
the powerhouse windows dim, back to the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Old turbines would be damaged that low, so new ones should win back at least 160 megawatts. Until then, as Lake Mead falls, so does Hoover Dam's power.
